Features:

➧ 4K high-definition video helps you collect clearer videos.

➧ Hot spot WiFi, real-time monitoring. Voice synchronization during video recording.

➧ This wearable camera has video/audio/photo/playback functions.

➧ Equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable battery, it can provide up to 8 hours of recording time.

➧ Limited to external storage, supports TF cards up to 128GB, and can format the card itself.

➧ Pre - and post recording, never missing any important moments, file protection function keeps you safe.

➧ This police body camera adopts a back clip design, which is practical, lightweight, and easy to place and clip in clothes and pockets.

➧ The multiple advantages and stability of video security cameras make them suitable for a wide range of scenarios, including police, traffic law enforcement, outdoor sports, etc. It has performance and durability that meet a wide range of needs, and can travel with users anytime, anywhere.

Specifications:

*Product Name: Police Camera

*Product model: ZC-M11

*WiFi function: hotspot WiFi (10 meters accessible)

*Screen size: 1.54 inch color screen

*Resolution: 4K/2k/1080P

*Video frame rate: 30fps

*Video format: AVI

*Image ratio: 4:3

*Rotation angle: 180 °

*Motion detection: support

*Night vision function: Supports

*Charging interface: type-c

*Battery capacity: 1000mAh

*Charging voltage: 5V/1A

*Charging time: 2 hours

*Working hours: 8 hours

*Application: Wind Recorder

*Memory card type: Micro SD card

*Memory expansion: up to 128GB Micro SD card (not included)

*Main features: WiFi, video recording, photography, recording, loop recording, motion detection, infrared night vision, file viewing, file deletion, formatting, back clip.

*Language support: Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, Korean, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Thai, Polish, Czech, Dutch, Turkish.

*Product size: approximately 105 * 40 * 25mm

*Product weight: approximately 70g

*Product color: Black

*Product Material: ABS

The packaging includes:

1 * WiFi camera

1 * User Manual

1 * Type-C cable

product.desc:
Versatile Use



Perfect for various outdoor activities such as cycling, hiking, and water sports, this camera is a versatile companion.






4K Ultra HD Resolution



Capture every detail with the W&O handheld camera's 4K Ultra HD resolution, ensuring crisp and clear footage.






Night Photography



Capture stunning night scenes with the camera's powerful night shooting features, enhancing your vlog content.






Stable Recording



Experience smooth, shake-free footage with the camera's advanced anti-shake technology, ideal for outdoor activities.






Portable Design



This compact pocket-sized camera is perfect for on-the-go vlogging, making it easy to capture moments anywhere.

3618688865.title: 4K GPS Bike Camera with Headlight Cycling Computer & Speedometer Sport Action DV 64GB, APP Control, IP65 Waterproof
3618688865.detail_text: 4K UHD Bike Camera & 6-Axis Stabilization】 Capture your rides in stunning 4K UHD at 30fps with 3 adjustable resolutions. Features 6-axis stabilization for smooth footage, even on rough terrain. Perfect for cycling, adventures, and safety recording. SPORT DV has 3 resolution settings: 3840x2160P, 2704x1520P, 1920x1080P. In the APP recording interface, click Recorder Settings and find the 'video resolution' setting item. 【Cycling Computer with GPS Tracking & Speedometer】 Cycling GPS Units record your rides while tracking real-time speed, distance, and routes via GPS. Features an 0.96in IPS Screen display for instant speed monitoring and app-viewable maps for post-ride analysis. Perfect for cyclists who want performance data and safety recording in one device. The first positioning takes about 1min in a stationary state; GPS positioning needs to be searched in an open outdoor location 【Sports Action Camera with Mobile Interconnection】 This action camera comes equipped with both Wi-Fi capabilities, allowing you to quickly and effortlessly playback, downloads, share and edit videos with the app. Simply download the app on your phone and connect with the camera. WiFi is provided for file transfer and APP use. The WiFi range of sport DV is 6-7 meters, which is NOT a cloud sport DV. With 64GB card is included with the sport DV (supports cards up to 512GB) 【IMX335 Night Vision Bicycle Camera & Long-Lasting】 Equipped with an advanced IMX335 sensor, it captures crystal-clear footage even at night. Features a 3-mode adaptive headlight (Strong/Low/Flash, 4000-4500K daylight) with one-touch control and rescue mode. The bike light can also be used independently. USB-C rechargeable (full in 3h), supports 2.5h recording+light, 5.5h recording-only, or 11h light-only. Perfect for commutes and long rides, ensuring reliable safety and performance anytime. 【IP65 Waterproof & Easy Mounting】 The cycling camera is IP65 waterproof—rainproof but not for immersion,otherwise it will cause external or internal damage. Installs in seconds on any bike (road/MTB/folding) with no tools or wiring. Suitable for all terrains and night rides. Can also be mounted on motorbikes, helmets, or bikes. Handlebar circumference ≤14cm/5.5in; strap length 15cm/5.9in, allow 1cm for tightening.
